sentences.text:
Also heard Mr. K. K. Das,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

This present application is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the Charge Sheet No. 418/2023 dated 31.10.2023 arising out of Dibrugarh P.S. Case No. 313/2023 registered under Section 406/420 of IPC.
Perused the FIR as well as the charge sheet.
From the reading of the FIR, it is apparently seen that the matter is primarily a civil dispute and a criminal colour has been given to it.
In view of the aforesaid, this matter needs further consideration.
Accordingly, issue notice returnable after four weeks.
As Mr. K. K. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice on behalf of the respondent No. 1, no formal notice need be issued to the said respondent.
The petitioner to take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondent No. 2 by way of registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within a period of five days from today.

Considering the nature of dispute, it is provided that till such return of notice, the further proceeding of PRC Case No. 1223/2023 (GR Case No. 907/2023) under Section 406/420 of IPC pending for trial before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Page No.# 3/3 Magistrate, Dibrugrah shall remain suspended.
